title: feat: add ElevenLabs voice isolator
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds paid-only direct ElevenLabs voice isolation at `POST /v1/audio/voice-isolator`, multiplier 1.
- Accepts audio or video in the `audio` multipart field and returns isolated speech as MP3.
- Bills provider-metered input at $0.12/min and fails closed with an error log when metering is absent.
- Uses no Pollinations GPU and has no fallback.

Validation:
- Live full-route 5-second WAV: exact 0.01 Pollen deduction.
- Direct 61-second probe: `character-cost=734`, 61.05-second playable output, confirming no one-minute billing floor.
- Direct provider WAV and MP4 inputs both returned playable MP3.
- 21 stacked focused tests and Gen typecheck pass.

Stacked on #12779 for endpoint-scoping and duration-metering infrastructure.

### Endpoint-gating follow-up (2026-07-26)

- Fixed the standard TTS routing regression introduced by endpoint metadata: generic audio defaults now include both /audio/{text} and /v1/audio/speech, and both routes pass their exact endpoint identity.
- Added route-level coverage for explicit elevenlabs, omitted/default model, and the simple GET route; all return 200.
- Latest stacked Gen verification: typecheck clean, paid modality E2E clean, and 694/694 tests across 74 files pass.
- Documented the measured 12 credits/second audio-input metering and its Scale-plan reconciliation in code.
- CI follow-up: the deterministic route test now injects a test-only provider key through the Worker environment; the secretless GitHub suite passes.

gist.headline: The hive finds the voice
gist.blurb: A new ElevenLabs voice isolator gently sweeps the background out of your audio. Send in a recording or video; get clean speech back as an MP3.
gist.summary: Added the paid ElevenLabs voice isolation endpoint at POST /v1/audio/voice-isolator, accepting audio or video multipart uploads and returning isolated speech as MP3 with per-second provider metering.
gist.impact: Developers can now extract playable, isolated speech from WAV, MP4, and other supported uploads through one Pollinations audio endpoint, while standard TTS routes continue working across their explicit and default model paths.
